sources.noaaTideStation: station 8447504 (South Yarmouth, Bass River) selected as primary tide station for issue #3. Station is a NOAA CO-OPS subordinate station (type S) located at the mouth of Bass River, Nantucket Sound, 1.8 km from West Dennis Beach. Subordinate to Boston (8443970). Time offsets: HW +108 min, LW +106 min; height ratio: 0.29. Hi-lo tide predictions retrieved successfully via NOAA CO-OPS Tide Predictions API on 2026-07-26. 6-minute interval predictions are not available for subordinate stations; hi-lo is the operational interval. Datum is MLLW (Mean Lower Low Water), the standard NOAA CO-OPS datum for US tide predictions. Fallback station 8447525 (Dennisport) verified independently on same date.

sources.nwsGridpoint: resolved via NWS Points API (https://api.weather.gov/points/41.6494,-70.1845) on 2026-07-26. Office BOX (Boston/Norton MA); grid X=107, Y=74. Point type is 'marine' (NWS classifies this cell as a marine forecast grid, forecast zone ANZ232 — Nantucket Sound). Hourly forecast, 12-hourly forecast, and grid data endpoints all confirmed reachable. Grid data endpoint provides windDirection in degrees and windGust in km/h, which are the preferred inputs for the decision engine. Radar station KBOX confirmed. Relative location returned by API is 'West Dennis, MA' at distance 0.

shore.seawardBearingDegrees: 195° assigned per issue #5 based on the south-southwest orientation of West Dennis Beach facing Nantucket Sound. The shoreline at this location (41.6494°N, −70.1845°W) runs WNW–ESE; the perpendicular toward open water is approximately SSW (190°–200°). Value 195° is a geographic estimate derived from published coordinates and publicly known Cape Cod shoreline orientation. Requires project owner verification against an authoritative geographic source (e.g. NOAA nautical chart 13229, which was also identified as the relevant chart in the NOAA station metadata for station 8447504) before the spot is activated.

shore.acceptedWindSectors / prohibitedWindSectors: sectors computed from seawardBearingDegrees 195° using fixed angular thresholds: DIRECT_ONSHORE within ±30°, SIDE_ONSHORE within ±75°, CROSS_SHORE within ±90°, SIDE_OFFSHORE within ±135°, OFFSHORE beyond ±135°. DIRECT_ONSHORE and SIDE_ONSHORE are accepted; all others are prohibited. The OFFSHORE sector (330°–60°) wraps through 0°/360°. Sector boundaries assume the bearing is correct; if the bearing is adjusted, sector boundaries must be recalculated. See docs/shore-bearing.md for domain review examples and verification guidance.
